description: This file defines the implementation of error status handling within the TensorFlow Go API, including the status struct, functions to create, manage, and convert status objects, and error handling logic.

classes.name: status
classes.description: Represents the error status returned by TensorFlow operations, wrapping the C TF_Status pointer.

classes.name: statusError
classes.description: A wrapper that fulfills the Go error interface for TensorFlow status errors.

methods.name: newStatus
methods.description: Creates a new status object, with a finalizer set for cleanup.

methods.name: finalizer
methods.description: Finalizer method to delete the C status object when the Go status object is garbage collected.

methods.name: Code
methods.description: Returns the TensorFlow status code as a 'code' type.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the status message as a string.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Converts the status to a Go error if it's not OK; returns nil otherwise.

search-terms: Go binding for TensorFlow C API
